name: windy-plugin-cma-typhoon
description: Windy plugin for tracking typhoon with CMA data, 18-level Beaufort scale and color-coded tracks

scripts.build: powershell -Command "$env:SERVE='false'; $env:CONFIG='src'; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist -EA SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist -Force; npx rollup -c; Copy-Item package.json dist/; Copy-Item src/screenshot.jpg dist/ -EA SilentlyContinue"
scripts.build:all-examples: for number in 01 02 03 04 05 06; do CONFIG=example$number SERVE=false rollup -c; done

author: jianghanzhi2006-dotcom
